status: Secondary experiment registered before any new TRAIN/DEV result was consulted or TEST score generated. Primary selection and all hypotheses in protocol.json remain fixed.
question: Do weights on the frozen purchase representation suffice to correct the seen decision errors, and does an exact local weight change transfer better than a matched gradient update?
head: Use the full-svd-.1 TRAIN head on the same 18 standardized and clipped free cues plus intercept. Raw action threshold is 0.30. Both training methods start at this same head. Conditional readout task only.
objective: Minimize source-weighted |d| times hinge(.10-sign(d)*(gain-.30)), d=paid correctness-free correctness-.30, with 1e-5 times L1 displacement. Train only on new TRAIN. Same editable coordinates including intercept, same L1 radii 0,.25,1,4.
methods: One exact LP per nonzero radius versus 64 full-batch projected subgradient steps on identical piecewise-linear loss. Track the best train objective including the origin. Step .25/sqrt(iteration), Euclidean projection onto the same L1 ball. Choose radius independently for each method by DEV macro utility, worst DEV source gain vs free, smaller radius. Record all time and failures. No edits to sensory frontends, old HCSN dynamics or TEST.
conditioning: Before TEST archive both methods' four heads, chosen radii, TRAIN/DEV result and formula/source hashes. On fresh TEST report both frozen methods with the original price; direct improvement requires beating matched gradient and incumbent at the original primary quality and group thresholds. Numerical optimization advantage alone does not warrant adoption.
retrospective_capacity: After confirmation, on each split's actual observations separately, solve LP feasibility for the hindsight action labels (buy exactly for a rescue) on the same fixed training-standardized 18 features. Report minimum L1 displacement to separate all decisions at margin .10 if feasible. A TEST-label fit is an expressivity diagnostic only, never a deployed update or evidence of transfer.
implementation: scipy.optimize.linprog(method=highs), analytic primal feasibility and verify one-step gradient shape plus realized decision/payoff independently. Equality comparisons tolerate 1e-8 in training objective. No claims about autonomous proposal discovery or full-model pretraining.
